thread:
sam: quick ask — can we soft-unpin model quant-v4b on the EU canary for tonight's small-batch jobs? deploybot shows a sticky pin for ~1% of sessions and it's skewing our latency p50. want to try an unpin + fallback routing test before full rollforward.
irene: do we know why it's sticky? last telemetry I saw looked like KV cache warmups causing OOM evictions for a very small cohort.
maddy: @irene saw similar. root cause looks like a kernel path mismatch when sessions are resumed across backend restarts (longseq + quant combos). not a showstopper but affects tail latency.
sam: right — not an outage, just noisy. proposal: soft-unpin EU canary for 1 hour night window and route affected requests to quant-v4b-compat (float16 variant) while we observe. fallback should be automated.
zoe: thumbs up on observation window but nightshift is short. can deploybot do a scoped unpin for only small-batch tag?
deploy-bot: @sam I can perform a scoped soft-unpin. command: ```/deploybot unpin --model quant-v4b --scope=canary-eu --tag=small-batch --mode=soft --duration=1h```
ops-oncall: if we do this, add telemetry hooks — token latency p50/p95, OOM counter, and convo-quality sampling. also add a rollback action in the thread so nightshift can revert quickly.
maddy: adding runbook fragment here: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/runtime/quant-unpin. we should prep quick rollback: ```/deploybot pin --model quant-v4b --scope=canary-eu --force``` (immediate)
irene: question about SDK: we recently shipped sdk-shim 2.7.1 which changes the header flags for resume. do we need to block until sdk is in canary?
sam: good catch. sdk telemetry shows <0.1% signature mismatch but it could interact. my read: safe to proceed for small-batch only; if mismatch rate rises above 0.5% we abort. ops-oncall can set that as a hard threshold.
ops-oncall: set alert: canary-eu/sdk-mismatch-rate > 0.5% -> auto-pin + page oncall. created alert ID RB-17001.
zoe: also want to ensure release-notes include this as "temporary soft-unpin and fallback routing" and note SDK shim caveat. I'll add a brief blurb.
maddy: schedule: do the unpin at 23:15 UTC, observe until 00:15 UTC. requests routed to compat variant automatically. if any p95 spike > 200ms or OOMs increment > 2/min, we pin back.
sam: @deploy-bot when you run it, post the deploybot job id here and the diff so we can audit.
deploy-bot: ack. standing by for `/deploybot unpin` from @sam or @maddy.
sam: running now: ```/deploybot unpin --model quant-v4b --scope=canary-eu --tag=small-batch --mode=soft --duration=1h --notify=eng-runtime,ops-oncall```
deploy-bot: job 1740001 started. diff: -pin: quant-v4b@stable 
 +soft-unpin: quant-v4b (canary-eu small-batch)
deploy-bot: routing policy updated: affected sessions will fallback to quant-v4b-compat when kernel mismatch detected.
ops-oncall: alerts wired. monitoring dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/runtime/canary-eu/quant-v4b (added sampling).
zoe: added short note to tonight's release notes doc: "Canary: soft-unpin quant-v4b for small-batch; watch sdk-shim mismatch. Auto-pin on threshold."
maddy: observed p50 improved slightly, p95 steady. OOM counter +0 (within noise). SDK mismatch at 0.12%. no action.
irene: rolling logs show a tiny spike in resumed-session errors but they're 200 OK fallbacks. looks healthy so far.
sam: thank you. leaving the window open till 00:15. if anyone sees worsening, shout here and ops-oncall will execute the pinback.
ops-oncall: note for postmortem: if we need to do a full rollback, follow runbook section "pinback-and-rollback" and coordinate with platform for warmup before rollforward.
zoe: I'll follow up in morning with a short summary and whether we can schedule a full unpin for the EU region next week.
deploy-bot: job 1740001 completed: soft-unpin applied. duration 1h.
sam: closing loop — thanks all. :thumbsup:
